# UX Checklist: SPEC-013A1 - GitHub Sync Automation and Poller Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for the GitHub Sync panel lifecycle UX, manual fallback separation, operator-readable status states, accessibility of status changes, and UI copy scope boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist ux` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec explicitly require automatic polling lifecycle controls in the GitHub Sync panel, including enablement, disablement, interval/bounds visibility or edit affordances, idempotent backoff reset, and flag/control-disabled states? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-044, Plan §UX Design Constraints, Contract §PATCH /api/github/sync/control]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec require manual sync fallback controls to remain discoverable and visibly or semantically separate from automatic polling lifecycle controls? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-046, Spec §SC-008, Plan §UX Design Constraints]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec require the GitHub Sync panel to expose active run, last run, last completed/success timestamps, last success cursor, last error, next eligible/retry time, backoff source/cap/fallback state, skipped-owner diagnostics, and health severity/reason as visible operator status? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-045, Plan §UX Design Constraints, Contract §GET /api/github/sync]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Are lifecycle result states required to appear as concise operator-readable labels or explanations rather than raw API codes only? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-047, Plan §UX Design Constraints, Data Model §Sync Run]
- [x] CHK005 Is the GitHub Sync panel placement requirement clear enough to prevent moving lifecycle controls into a generic scheduler or admin settings surface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, Plan §Out Of Scope]
- [x] CHK006 Are UI status changes required to be accessible to assistive technologies when success, waiting/running, progress, error, backoff, or recovery messages update without a page-level context change? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-049, Plan §UX Design Constraints]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are UI copy requirements consistent with the non-goal boundary that SPEC-013A1 must not imply task claim, task dispatch, remediation execution, harness lifecycle, sandbox lifecycle, auto-merge, or automatic triage behavior? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-048, Spec §SC-008, Plan §UX Design Constraints]
- [x] CHK008 Are planned UI affordances consistent with the existing Mission Control pattern of compact status rows, badges/dots, existing button variants, and no new icon-library dependency? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Codebase §src/components/panels/github-sync-panel.tsx]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are disabled, running, successful, failed/backoff, partial bounded stop, skipped overlap, rejected overlap, skipped owner, skipped non-owner, ownership unresolved, and stale-recovered states all covered by UI-understandability requirements? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-047, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK010 Are conflict and overlap states required to give operators actionable retry or active-run context in the panel, not just in the API response? [Gap resolved, Spec §FR-045, Spec §FR-047, Plan §Observability Design]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 Can UI verification objectively prove that operators can distinguish automatic polling controls from manual sync fallback controls and understand disabled, delayed, failed, partial, skipped, conflict, and stale-recovered states? [Gap resolved, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK012 Can reviewers objectively verify that the UI does not introduce task claim, remediation execution, harness, sandbox, auto-merge, or triage behavior as part of this feature? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-022, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Notes

- Initial UX checklist found nine gaps around explicit automatic lifecycle controls, manual fallback separation, visible status completeness, human-readable lifecycle state copy, accessible status updates, forbidden out-of-scope UI wording, UI-understandability state coverage, conflict context, and objective UI verification.
- Remediation added Spec FR-044 through FR-049 and SC-008, plus Plan §UX Design Constraints, expanded Plan §Observability Design, and focused UI/e2e verification bullets.
